item.title: OpenAI & Founders Fund Invest in Brain‑Tumor Implant
item.description: OpenAI’s venture arm and Peter Thiel’s Founders Fund invest $45 M in Coherence Neuro, a startup building a brain‑implant that detects and treats tumors.

item.title: Neurable One: Brain‑Scanning Headphones for Focus
item.description: Neurable releases the $499 Neurable One, a Bluetooth headset with 12 EEG sensors that provides focus alerts, burnout detection, and guided meditation.
